scientific_integrity: The general results follow from symbolic proofs. Finite field enumerations are corroborative and incomplete as a proof of universal quantification. External independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: An older paper on unqualified idempotent generators was not read in full, so priority remains uncertain. The exact count applies to three rank-one idempotent generators of 3-by-3 matrix algebras.
title: Rank-one idempotent generation: directed reachability and an exact three-dimensional count
